name: bua_analysis
description: Fetches the current global BUA Data Structure and instructs the LLM to analyze it for misinformation, safety inconsistencies, or missing compliance data.

inputs.name: focus_area
inputs.description: Specify 'all' for a full review, or a specific section like 'strains' or 'personnel' to focus the analysis.

outputs.description: Returns the current BUA form data and strict instructions for the LLM on how to generate the compliance report.
